title: make_unique and Scope
hints: `std::make_unique<Tracked>(v)` allocates the object and wraps it in one expression. There should be no `new` anywhere in your code.
A `unique_ptr` can be empty, and it tests like a pointer: `return p ? p->value : -1;`. Dereferencing an empty one is the same crash as dereferencing a null raw pointer.
